description: [PAID $0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] One-shot LLM completion on Cloudflare Workers AI with a minimal interface: give `prompt` (and optionally `system`, or OpenAI-style `messages`), get {text, model, finish_reason, usage}.
